home.aboutUsDescription: An intimate fine-dining restaurant serving seasonal European cuisine. Reserve your table with us.
home.homeDescription: THE TERMINAL is an intimate fine-dining restaurant set inside a restored freight house at the end of an old line — a seasonal European menu, candle-lit evenings, and a kitchen devoted to craft over speed.
home.homeDescription2: Every detail — from salvaged oak and lime-washed brick to the single brass lamp from the original station office — is composed with intention, so each course arrives like a postcard and every glass pours like a ticket to somewhere finer.
